name: AI情感陪伴 - 主动关怀工作流

parameters.query:
SELECT ct.*, u.name as user_name, u.user_id, p.persona_id, p.persona_name, p.prompt_template, p.personality_traits
FROM care_tasks ct
JOIN users u ON ct.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN ai_personas p ON ct.persona_id = p.persona_id
WHERE ct.is_active = true
  AND ct.schedule_time = CURRENT_TIME::time
  AND (ct.schedule_days IS NULL OR EXTRACT(DOW FROM CURRENT_DATE) = ANY(ct.schedule_days))

nodes.name: 拆分任务
nodes.notes: 逐个处理每个用户的任务

parameters.query:
SELECT emotion, AVG(intensity) as avg_intensity
FROM emotion_tracking
WHERE user_id = '{{ $json.user_id }}'
  AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY emotion
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) as message_count, MAX(created_at) as last_message
FROM messages
WHERE user_id = '{{ $json.user_id }}'
  AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT * FROM important_dates
WHERE user_id = '{{ $json.user_id }}'
  AND (
    (recurrence = 'yearly' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_value) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_value) = EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE))
    OR (date_value = CURRENT_DATE)
  )
UPDATE care_tasks SET last_executed_at = NOW(), next_execution_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '1 day' WHERE task_id = '{{ $json.task_id }}'
